items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I played with them. Cantrell used to play drums, a fellow called Cantrell, used to play drums with him.

ctx.x: Old professor Ullett. He was one of the owners, one of the years used to play violin. I called him Ullett. I played with them. Cantrell used to play drums, a fellow called Cantrell, used to play drums with him. But I know his son.
